app.name: VPS Console
home.title: Check a VPS before you deploy
home.lead: Test SSH, system, routes to China and blocking in one go, then get a ready prompt for the deploy skill.
home.check: Server facts, ports, versions, return routes, GFW blocking, Cloudflare and proxy tests.
home.generate: Pick protocols and a save location, get a prompt and config for vps-deploy-skill.
home.convert: Turn links and subscriptions into a Mihomo config, share links and QR codes.
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.no_probe: No probe yet. Add one for China-side tests:
progress.reach: Testing reachability from abroad and China…
progress.forward_route: Tracing the route from the China probe…
check.title: Check a server
check.intro: Everything here is read-only. Nothing on the server is installed or changed.
check.quick_desc: About 30 s: system, ports, versions, Shanghai routes, China TCP test.
check.deep_desc: A few minutes: all 9 carrier routes, TLS on every port, forward route, Globalping.
check.secret_note: Passwords and keys are used for this check only. They are never saved or logged.
check.ports_hint: Empty: SSH port and 443 (deep mode adds every public port).
check.no_probe: No China probe configured. Globalping will be used. Add a probe under Admin.
check.cf_hint: Read-only: verifies the token and shows the DNS records. Nothing is changed.
check.proxy_hint: Residential, dynamic or static ISP proxies. Shows exit IP, network type and whether the IP is sticky.
field.proxy_scheme: Type when not in the line
field.ssh_key_path: Key path on the machine running the skill
field.title: Name
err.invalid_host: not a valid IP or hostname
err.private_ip: private or reserved addresses are not allowed
err.missing_secret: enter a password or key, or tick "No login"
err.nothing_to_check: enter a server, domain, token or proxy
err.exit_required: this preset needs an exit proxy
err.internal_error: the check stopped unexpectedly; see the server log
ssh.no_credentials: Enter a password or a private key.
ssh.bad_key: The private key could not be read. Encrypted keys are not supported.
ssh.auth_failed: Login refused: wrong user, password or key.
ssh.timeout: No SSH answer in time. Check the IP, port and firewall.
ssh.refused: Connection refused: nothing listens on that port.
ssh.host_key_changed: The server's host key changed since it was saved. Re-save it if you rebuilt the server.
ssh.key_install_failed: Could not add the SSH key on the server.
job.ip_hint: Network type comes from ip-api.com flags. It is a hint, not proof.
job.routes_hint: Traced from the server to each carrier. CN2 GIA, CU 9929 and CMIN2 are the premium lines. "Detour" means an Asian server with over 150 ms, usually traffic going via the US.
job.reach_hint: These tests catch IP, port and TLS blocking. A proxy protocol can still be detected after TLS works; only a real client in China proves that.
k.name: Name
verdict.down: No answer from anywhere. The server is down or firewalled, not a GFW block.
verdict.no_china_data: No China-side data. Add a China probe or try again later.
verdict.ip_blocked: IP blocked in China: nothing answers from China, but it works from abroad.
verdict.port_blocked: Port blocked in China: {ports}. Other ports work.
verdict.tls_interference: TLS cut in China on {ports}: TCP connects but the handshake fails.
verdict.reachable: Reachable from China on every tested port.
gp.no_probes: No Globalping probes available in China right now.
gp.rate_limited: Globalping limit reached. Add a token under Admin.
cf.zone_not_in_token: This token can't see the domain's zone.
cf.ssl_unknown: not readable with this token; use Full (strict)
f.os_unknown: {name}: not in the tested list. Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04 are recommended.
f.os_ended: {name}: support ended {end}. Fine for now, but use Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04 for a new server.
f.os_ending: {name}: support ends {end}. Plan a move to Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04.
f.lxd_possible: LXD works on {virt}. Fits about {containers} container(s) with ~{memory} MB each.
f.lxd_container_vps: LXD can't run here: this VPS is itself a container ({virt}).
f.lxd_too_small: Too small to split with LXD (needs about 1 GB RAM and 8 GB free disk).
f.kernel_old: Kernel {kernel} is old. 5.15 or newer is recommended.
f.swap_none: No swap. Add 1–2 GB with swappiness 10 as a safety net.
f.swap_large: {swap} GB of swap is more than needed; 1–2 GB is enough.
f.swappiness_high: vm.swappiness is {value}. 10 keeps proxies out of swap.
f.bbr_off: BBR is available but off (using {cc}). The skills turn it on.
f.port_http01_busy: Port 80 is used by {process}. The skill needs it for HTTP-01 certificates, or use DNS-01.
f.port_https_busy: Port 443 is used by {process}. REALITY or the CDN node will pick another port.
f.port_sub_busy: Port 2096 is used by {process}. Set another subscription port.
f.skill_present: vps-deploy-skill was run here before. Re-runs keep links and ports.
f.firewall_active: {name} is active. Make sure the new ports get opened.
gen.title: Deploy prompt
gen.intro: Fill in the details once. You get a prompt and config for vps-deploy-skill to paste into your agent.
gen.domain_hint: Needed for the CDN, single-443 and real-certificate presets.
gen.manage_dns: Let the skill create the Cloudflare DNS records
gen.exit_hint: For residential exits (e.g. DataImpulse). User and password go in the secrets section or stay as placeholders.
gen.panel_private: Keep the 3X-UI panel private (SSH tunnel only)
gen.lxc: Split the server with LXD first
gen.use_lxc: Use vps-lxc-skill to make containers first
gen.save_hint: The skill writes results here on the machine running it. The server keeps its own state in /etc/vps-skill/state.json, so no path is needed there. This page is also saved under History for download.
gen.secrets_hint: By default no secrets go into the prompt: the skill reads VPS_SSH_PASS and CF_TOKEN from the environment. A prompt with secrets is shown once and never saved.
gen.include_secrets: Put these secrets into the prompt
gen.stored: Saved under History. No secrets are in it.
gen.not_stored: This prompt contains secrets. It was not saved. Copy it now.
preset.fast_desc: REALITY + Hysteria 2 on the bare IP. No domain needed.
preset.complete_desc: REALITY + Hysteria 2 + Cloudflare CDN fallback. Needs a domain.
preset.stealth443_desc: REALITY on 443 behind your own website, plus CDN. Needs a domain.
preset.visiontls_desc: VLESS + TLS + Vision for clients without REALITY. Needs a domain.
preset.residential_desc: All traffic leaves through your residential proxy. Metered.
save.custom_desc: any folder on the machine running the skill
conv.title: Subscription converter
conv.intro: Runs on this server; nothing is sent to third-party converters.
conv.or_yaml: or a Clash YAML / base64 subscription
conv.publish: Publish a subscription URL for clients
conv.resi_hint: Matching nodes go in their own manual group and are never latency-tested, to save metered traffic and keep sticky sessions.
conv.sub_hint: Anyone with this URL can download the config. Delete it under History to revoke. Add ?format=base64 for v2rayN.
hist.intro: Checks and generated files are kept here. Secrets never are.
admin.probes_intro: A VPS in China used for China-side tests. Credentials are encrypted and never shown again after you save them.
admin.confirm_delete: Delete this server? Its SSH key is removed from it too.
admin.switch_key: Swap the password for a dedicated SSH key (recommended)
admin.secret_hint: The login is checked first. With the swap on, the password is used once to add a key and then discarded; only the encrypted key is kept.
admin.probe_saved: Saved. The secret is encrypted and won't be shown again.
admin.gp_hint: Optional. Raises the free limit of about 250 tests per hour. Get one at globalping.io.
account.weak: Passwords don't match or are shorter than 12 characters.
